title: Montreal
subtitle: A short visit, kept in three photographs: the city, an underground wall and a leafy waterway.

chapters.title: A short Montreal visit
paragraphs: Three photographs remain from the visit: a city view, artwork on an underground wall and a tree-lined waterway.
